evals.prompt: Install OSMO on my existing AKS cluster. I have not chosen a topology or secret strategy yet.
evals.expected_output: The agent activates osmo-deploy, asks for the exact context, topology profile, pinned release, secret mode, storage, scheduler, GPU needs, and gateway exposure before changing the cluster.
assertions: The agent reads and activates osmo-deploy.
The agent asks for the exact kube context and namespace.
The agent asks the user to choose single-node, minimal, split-control, or split-compute.
The agent asks for a pinned chart/source revision and matching image tag.
The agent asks for existing Secrets or External Secrets and NVault details for production.
The agent does not propose Terraform, cluster provisioning, or a deployment shell script.

evals.prompt: I have a local single-node Kubernetes cluster. Show me the supported OSMO install and verification flow.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses the umbrella chart with the single-node profile, renders first, installs one Helm release, and runs helm test with logs.
assertions: The agent reads and activates osmo-deploy.
The agent uses deployments/charts/osmo/profiles/single-node.yaml.
The agent runs helm dependency build, helm lint or template, then helm upgrade --install.
The agent runs helm test with --logs after installation.
The agent describes generated Secrets as development-only.
The agent does not install the service and backend-operator charts separately.

evals.prompt: Deploy split-plane OSMO with NVault-managed secrets.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses the split-control and split-compute profiles in separate pinned contexts, configures External Secrets against NVault, and shares the backend token without exposing it.
assertions: The agent reads and activates osmo-deploy.
The agent selects split-control.yaml and split-compute.yaml.
The agent asks for both kube contexts and the externally reachable service URL.
The agent requires External Secrets Operator and an NVault-backed SecretStore or ClusterSecretStore.
The agent requires both planes to resolve the same backend token.
The agent does not print or pass raw Secret values through Helm flags.

evals.prompt: I need GPU workflows with KAI on EKS. Can OSMO create the cluster and GPU nodes too?
evals.expected_output: The agent explains that cluster and GPU provisioning are platform-owned, verifies GPU Operator and KAI prerequisites, and installs OSMO through the umbrella chart after the cluster is conformant.
assertions: The agent reads and activates osmo-deploy.
The agent says OSMO Helm does not provision EKS, node groups, networking, or IAM.
The agent requires allocatable nvidia.com/gpu and a working NVIDIA GPU Operator or equivalent.
The agent requires KAI CRDs before selecting the kai scheduler.
The agent uses the umbrella chart after prerequisites are ready.
The agent does not recommend an OSMO Terraform provider or deployment wrapper.

evals.prompt: My workflow train-123 has been pending for an hour. Can you inspect its events and logs?
evals.expected_output: This is live workflow troubleshooting, so osmo-deploy does not trigger and the request routes to the OSMO user workflow.
assertions: The agent does not activate osmo-deploy.
The agent routes to osmo-user or appropriate workflow troubleshooting.
The agent does not change Helm, cluster configuration, or deployment topology.
